name: The Torch of Retribution
summary: With the torch made, Kalaran Windblade says it now needs an owner to be bound to, and tells you to pick it up.

sections.title: Binding the Flame
sections.body: Kalaran says the torch needs to be bound to its owner. To do that, you are told to take it up yourself.

sections.title: The Torch in Hand
sections.body: You take the torch in both hands, and hatred and anger pulse through you in waves.

faq.q: Who tells you to take the torch?
faq.answer: Kalaran Windblade, who says it needs to be bound to its owner.

faq.q: Why must you pick up the torch?
faq.answer: Kalaran says the torch must be bound to its owner, and tells you to take it up.

faq.q: Where does this step fit into the chain?
faq.answer: It follows the earlier Torch of Retribution step, in which you waited while Kalaran combined the pieces and enchanted them.
